response.sql:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
  WHERE avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.avg_humidity,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg
    AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as mean_kept_humidity
  FROM filtered_equipment
),
result AS (
  SELECT 
    fe.equipref,
    fe.avg_humidity,
    fe.avg_humidity - fe.overall_avg as exceeds_overall,
    fe.avg_humidity - km.mean_kept_humidity as diff_from_kept_mean
  FROM filtered_equipment fe
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  avg_humidity,
  exceeds_overall,
  diff_from_kept_mean
FROM result
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Average of all equipment averages" means the arithmetic mean of per-equipment average humidity values, not the average of all individual readings across all equipment.
"Mean humidity of just the kept equipment" refers to the mean of the per-equipment average humidity values for the kept equipment, not the mean of all individual humidity readings.
"Above" means strictly greater than (>), not greater-than-or-equal-to.

alternatives.interpretation: Both "average of all equipment averages" and "mean humidity of just the kept equipment" are interpreted as averages of all individual humidity readings: the overall average is the average of all readings across all equipment, and the kept mean is the average of all readings for the filtered equipment only.
